about: Place names the player is told (ink UI round, gen/ui/STYLE.md 'Place notifications'). region: the large banner shown when you walk into this section's region (sections sharing a region id show it once). landmarks: a vertical name plaque stands over the map entity id as you approach (江南百景圖's plaques), and a toast with the line from the painting's reading when you come within r metres of its footprint (or its point); top: the plaque's height when the map has none. Every name and line in 繁體, from the painting and its readings; src says where. Lore (round 2, gen/ui/r2_lore.md): long is the longer description under the toast's fold and in the 圖志 journal; quote and quoteSrc an exact line from a period or scholarly source; cite the sources as the player reads them; longSrc one note per claim (never shown); crop the map IDs that frame the painting's crop (tools/place_crops.mjs). Bundled for the page by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/places.json (short) and lore.json (long, fetched when needed). Every displayed field has an English sibling `<field>_en`, shown as a gloss under the Chinese when the viewer picks 中英 (Chinese stays the default).

region.name: 虹橋
region.src: map/sections.json S3 '虹桥'; 余辉 2014 / 《导览》 拱桥上下; 名画记 18 虹桥
region.long: 長卷行到中段，便是全畫最驚險的一幕。一條大船正要穿過虹橋，桅桿還沒放倒，船工有的撐篙抵住橋身，有的大聲呼喊；橋上的人探身拋下繩索，看熱鬧的擠滿了橋欄。橋面上，一頂轎子和一位騎馬的官人迎面相逢，隨從各不相讓。余輝說這是全卷矛盾的高潮；曹星原更把這場搶險讀作全畫的主旨「同舟共濟」。橋頭，十千腳店的彩樓歡門高高搭起。
region.long_en: In the middle of the long scroll comes the most nerve-racking scene in the whole painting. A big boat is about to pass under the Rainbow Bridge, its mast not yet lowered; some boatmen brace poles against the bridge, others shout at the top of their voices, and people on the bridge lean over to throw down ropes while onlookers crowd the railings. On the deck of the bridge, a sedan chair and an official on horseback meet head-on, and the retinues give no ground. Yu Hui says this is the climax of the conflicts in the whole scroll; Cao Xingyuan reads this rescue as the painting's central theme, “all in the same boat.” At the bridgehead, the festive welcome gate of the Shiqian Tavern is raised high.
region.quote: 畫橋虹臥浚儀渠，兩岸風煙天下無。
region.quote_en: The painted bridge lies like a rainbow over the Junyi canal; the mist and wind on both banks have no equal under heaven.
region.quoteSrc: 金元之際 張世積跋
region.cite: 故宮名畫記・余輝〈十大看點〉・曹星原・韓森
region.cite_en: Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Yu Hui, Ten Highlights · Cao Xingyuan · Hansen
longSrc: Hansen 1996 (SEC §1.6): the bridge "appears just at its halfway point"
MHJ 19, 20: the boat at the bridge, crew lowering the mast, poling against the bridge, shouting; ropes thrown from the bridge; crowds
YH15 看点三: 坐轿的文官与骑马的武官互不相让，轿夫与马弁各仗其势; 形成了《清》卷的矛盾高潮

landmarks.name: 虹橋
landmarks.line_en: The bridge has no piers, like a flying rainbow.
landmarks.src: 《东京梦华录》卷一 河道: '其桥无柱，皆以巨木虚架，饰以丹雘，宛如飞虹'; 名画记 18
landmarks.long: 這座橋沒有一根橋柱，用大木一根根交錯穿插，架成一道拱，橫跨汴河。汴河水勢暴漲暴落，有柱的橋年年被沖壞；無柱的木拱不受激流衝擊，經久不壞。據《澠水燕談錄》，這種「飛橋」最早是青州一名牢城廢卒想出來的，後來汴河上都照樣建造，俗稱虹橋。明清的仿本把它畫成了石拱橋，故宮說這段原畫對研究宋代橋樑異常珍貴。
landmarks.long_en: This bridge has not a single pier. Great timbers are interwoven one over another to make an arch across the Bian Canal. The Bian's waters rise and fall violently, and bridges with piers were wrecked year after year; a pier-less timber arch is not struck by the rushing current and lasts. According to Mianshui Yantan Lu, this kind of “flying bridge” was first thought up by a discharged soldier of a prison camp in Qingzhou, and afterwards the same was built all along the Bian, commonly called the Rainbow Bridge. Copies from the Ming and Qing paint it as a stone arch, and the Palace Museum says this stretch of the original painting is extraordinarily precious for studying Song bridges.
landmarks.quote: 其橋無柱，皆以巨木虛架，飾以丹雘，宛如飛虹。
landmarks.quote_en: The bridge has no piers; it is spanned in the air with huge timbers, decked in cinnabar red, like a flying rainbow.
landmarks.cite: 《東京夢華錄》・《澠水燕談錄》・故宮名畫記
landmarks.cite_en: Dreams of Splendour of the Eastern Capital · Mianshui Yantan Lu · Palace Museum, Minghuaji
longSrc: map S3.str.rainbow_bridge: single-span arched timber bridge with no piers, woven-beam arch (编木拱)
MHJ 18: 汴河的水暴涨暴落，几乎年年都会毁坏桥梁…没有桥柱，不直接受到激流冲击，所以坚固耐用…明清…仿本…画成了石拱桥; 异常珍贵
MS 卷八: 会得牢城废卒，有智思…架为飞桥，无柱…至今沿汴皆飞桥…俗曰虹桥
quote: DJ 卷一 河道

landmarks.name: 十千腳店
landmarks.line: 腳店門首，也縛著綵樓歡門。
landmarks.line_en: This small tavern also has a festive welcome gate.
landmarks.src: the painted lamp-box 十千脚店 (S3.prop.lamp_box_jiaodian_17035); 《东京梦华录》卷二 '其余皆谓之脚店'; 余辉 2014 欢楼美禄
landmarks.long: 橋頭的酒店，門前燈箱正面寫「腳店」，側面寫「十千」，合起來便是「十千腳店」。按《東京夢華錄》，京城正店之外的酒家都叫腳店，多向正店打酒來賣。這家腳店門樓頂上也搭起高聳的彩樓歡門，樓上坐著飲酒的客人，門外拴著一匹備了鞍的馬。門前一輛串車正在裝貨，故宮名畫記說貨物像一串串銅錢；余輝卻說車上蓋的是一面遭廢的草書屏風。
landmarks.long_en: The tavern at the bridgehead has a lantern box in front reading “Leg Tavern” on its face and “Shiqian” on its side, which together make “Shiqian Leg Tavern.” According to Dreams of Splendour of the Eastern Capital, wine houses in the capital other than the main taverns are all called leg taverns, and mostly buy their wine from main taverns to resell. This leg tavern also has a tall festive welcome gate raised over its gatehouse, guests drinking upstairs, and a saddled horse tied outside. In front a string cart is being loaded; the Palace Museum's notes say the goods look like strings of copper coins, while Yu Hui says what is covered on the cart is a discarded cursive-script screen.
landmarks.quote: 其正酒店戶，見腳店三兩次打酒，便敢借與三五百兩銀器。
landmarks.quote_en: When a main tavern has seen a leg tavern come for wine two or three times, it will dare lend it three or five hundred taels of silver vessels.
landmarks.cite: 《東京夢華錄》・故宮名畫記・余輝〈十大看點〉・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Dreams of Splendour of the Eastern Capital · Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Yu Hui, Ten Highlights · What the painting shows
longSrc: map S3.prop.lamp_box_jiaodian_17035: front face 腳店, east side face 十千

landmarks.name: 新酒
landmarks.src: 名画记 23 新酒 (the painted banner)
landmarks.long: 腳店前立著一根高桿，桿頂有隻鳥形的風標，橫桿上垂下一面長旗，寫著「新酒」。故宮名畫記說，宋代酒稅收入極高，官府對酒實行專賣；「新酒」特指中秋前後開賣的酒，開賣時還要舉行隆重的迎酒儀式。也正因如此，孔憲易拿這面旗作證，說畫的是秋天。汴河岸邊另有一面「小酒」旗，可見當時飲酒風氣之盛。
landmarks.long_en: In front of the leg tavern stands a tall pole topped with a bird-shaped weathervane, and from a crosspiece hangs a long flag reading “New Wine.” The Palace Museum's notes say that wine taxes in the Song were very high and the government held a monopoly on wine; “new wine” means wine that goes on sale around the Mid-Autumn Festival, opened with a grand ceremony of welcoming the wine. For this reason Kong Xianyi cites this flag as evidence that the painting shows autumn. Another flag, “Small Wine,” stands on the bank of the Bian, a sign of how strong the habit of drinking was then.
landmarks.quote: 中秋節前，諸店皆賣新酒，重新結絡門面彩樓花頭。
landmarks.quote_en: Before the Mid-Autumn Festival, all the taverns sell new wine and put up fresh flower-topped festive gates on their fronts.
landmarks.cite: 故宮名畫記・《東京夢華錄》・孔憲易
landmarks.cite_en: Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Dreams of Splendour of the Eastern Capital · Kong Xianyi
longSrc: map S3.prop.xinjiu_flagpole_17630: tall pole, bird-shaped wind vane, bar to the 彩楼 scaffold, banner 新酒
MHJ 23: 宋朝酒税收入很高…官方对酒进行专卖…"新酒"特指在中秋节前后开始售卖的酒…隆重的迎酒仪式…"小酒"和"新酒"…可见当时饮酒的风气之盛
